billing.title: Plan & billing
billing.hint: Your plan, what you use, your invoices and how to change plan.
billing.noAccess: Only the owner can open this page
billing.noAccessHint: Ask the owner of the business to look after the plan and invoices.
billing.loadFailed: Your plan could not be loaded.
billing.plansFailed: The list of plans could not be loaded.
billing.unmanaged: Billing does not apply to this business. There is no subscription to pay and no plan limits.
billing.cancelNotice: Your subscription is cancelled and ends on {{date}}. Until then everything keeps working. Your data is kept.
billing.requestSent: You asked for the {{plan}} plan. The vendor has been told and will send you an invoice. The plan changes once it is paid.
billing.cancelAsk: Your subscription will keep working until {{date}}. After that the business becomes read-only: you can still see your records but cannot add new ones. Your data is kept, and you can come back at any time.
billing.cancelled: Your subscription will end at the end of the period.
billing.usageHint: Your use compared with what your plan allows.
billing.nearLimit: You are close to the limit. Consider a bigger plan.
billing.overLimit: You are over the limit. Move to a bigger plan to add more.
billing.unitsOver: Switched on, but not in your plan. They keep their data but cannot be switched on again once off:
billing.noInvoicesHint: When the vendor sends you an invoice it will appear here.
billing.popupBlocked: The invoice could not open. Allow pop-ups for this site and try again.
billing.changeHint: Pick a plan and ask for it. Asking does not charge you: the vendor sends an invoice first.
billing.noPlans: No plans are on offer right now. Please contact the vendor.
billing.requestLocked: You already have a request waiting. Withdraw it to ask for a different plan.
billing.requestExplain: We will tell the vendor, and they will send you an invoice. Nothing is charged now, and your plan stays the same until the invoice is paid.
billing.requestDone: Request sent. The vendor will send you an invoice.
billing.licenceHint: This copy of Ziira runs on your own server and is covered by a licence file from the vendor.
billing.updatesEnded: Your right to updates has ended. The software keeps working, but new versions need a renewal.
billing.renewalDue: Your licence is due for renewal soon. Ask the vendor for a new licence file and install it below.
billing.instanceHint: Give this to the vendor: a licence is made for this installation only.
billing.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it by hand.
billing.installHint: Choose the licence file from the vendor, or paste its text.
billing.subscribeExplain: An invoice is made for this plan and you can pay it straight away. Your plan changes as soon as the payment is confirmed.

pay.title: Pay invoice {{number}}
pay.method: How would you like to pay?
pay.manual: Online payment is not available for this invoice. Pay the way described below, and we will mark it paid.
pay.promptHint: We send a prompt to your phone. Enter your PIN there to approve it.
pay.redirectHint: You will be taken to the payment page, then brought back here.
pay.checkPhone: Check your phone and enter your PIN
pay.waitingProvider: Waiting for the payment to be confirmed
pay.countdown: Waiting to hear back about {{amount}}: {{seconds}} s left
pay.paid: Payment received: {{amount}}. Reference {{reference}}. Your plan is up to date.
pay.failed: The payment did not go through. Nothing was charged.
pay.mismatch: We received a payment that does not match this invoice, so we have not applied it. Our team has been told and will sort it out with you.
pay.timeout: We have not heard back. If you paid, it will appear shortly.
pay.cancelledReturn: You left the payment page without paying.

notice.trialEnding: Your trial ends in {{count}} days. Choose a plan to keep going.
notice.trialToday: Your trial ends today. Choose a plan to keep going.
notice.trialEnded: Your trial ended on {{date}}. Choose a plan to keep going. Your data is safe.
notice.suspended: Your plan ended on {{date}}. Pay to keep going. Your data is safe.
notice.suspendedNoDate: Your plan has ended. Pay to keep going. Your data is safe.
notice.overdue: A payment is overdue. Pay now to keep full access.

billing.addonsHint: Each was a single payment. They stay with your business when your plan changes.
billing.addonsNone: You have not bought any add-ons.
